question: What do the first-party surfaces of Sardex, WIR, the Credit Commons protocol, Holo/HoloFuel and Unyt state about mutual-credit scale, limits and federation, and what do the academic evaluations report?

frame.exposure: first-party statistics, protocol documents, peer-reviewed studies

item.title: SardexPay site: 15-year news item (2025-06-21) and home page

findings.finding: Sardex states, for 2025-06-20: "15 anni, 10.000 aziende e +1 miliardo di crediti transati"; network across 15 Italian regions; started 2010 by four young Sardinians; over 300 entrepreneurs at the Cagliari anniversary event.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: 15 anni, 10.000 aziende e +1 miliardo di crediti transati

findings.finding: Sardex states its purpose as creating concrete business opportunities and "fornire credito senza il peso degli interessi": credit without the burden of interest; the home page describes paying in Sardex "a tasso zero" and recouping by selling to other members.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: fornire credito senza il peso degli interessi

findings.finding: Sardex SpA is a joint-stock company (registered office Serramanna, share capital paid 187,862 EUR); the home page cites Il Sole 24 Ore 2021-05-03 "SardexPay corre e cresce dell'80%". The site lists pages Governance and Codice etico.

notFound: annual turnover by year and member credit-limit rules; not on the pages read

item.title: Credit Commons Microservices (gitlab.com/credit-commons-software-stack): fundamentals document and README

findings.finding: Protocol: nodes are web services with a Ledger API; nodes form a tree with rootwards/leafwards relations and no direct peers; a node has at least two accounts and at most one rootwards account; the rootwards account is the Balance-of-Trade (BoT) account, which members commit to restore to zero in the long run. A transversal transaction is recorded on every intermediate node as a transaction between two of that node's accounts.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: The relationship between any pair of connected nodes is a 'rootwards/leafwards relationship - there are no direct peer relationships.

findings.finding: Limits: "Accounts can only trade within limits straddling zero. E.g. +100, -100"; a transaction is valid only if the payee's resulting balance is below the maximum and the payer's resulting balance above the minimum; limits or the algorithm setting them come from a governance process, possibly negotiation among members. Each branchwards node has a conversion rate to its rootwards node.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: Accounts can only trade within limits straddling zero.

findings.finding: Integrity: nodes keep the same record of a shared transaction by a hash chain over transaction id, workflow name, version number and entry quantities and descriptions; workflows are JSON state machines saying which account may take which transition; parents by default cannot interrogate child ledgers and store no trader names for remote transactions.

Repository state: shallow clone last commit 2021-02-22; README section "WHAT WE NEED" is empty. Slater's blog (2020-10-06) announced the reference implementation as "a decade of working with community currencies" and said development "will have to come from government or philanthropic organisations, users (or future users) and/or volunteers."

notFound: any deployed network or user count

item.title: Holo Hosting: Pricing and currency page

findings.finding: Status stated by Holo: "HoloFuel is designed as the mutual-credit utility currency for accounting within the hosting network and has not launched." Hosting is priced per deployment and settled in national currencies such as USD and EUR; HOT was issued in 2018 as a product pre-sale voucher and "Holo Limited does not currently offer token exchange, conversion or redemption services".
findings.exactSourceLanguage: HoloFuel is designed as the mutual-credit utility currency for accounting within the hosting network and has not launched.

findings.finding: Until HoloFuel exists as the internal accounting system, micro-payments and direct peer payments between customers and hosts are not supported. HOT was documented in 2018 as redeemable for HoloFuel at 1:1 once operational.

item.title: Unyt site: how it works, roadmap, FAQ

findings.finding: Unyt describes itself as an accounting engine "built to power HoloFuel for the Holo Hosting network" that lets a group define currencies (including mutual credit with configurable credit limits, fees and membership requirements), Smart Agreements (billing, escrow, revenue sharing), atomic multi-currency trades and bridging of EVM tokens; it runs peer to peer on participants' devices on Holochain and in Moss groupware.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: Unyt's accounting engine was built to power HoloFuel for the Holo Hosting network

findings.finding: Roadmap dates stated: Unyt launch September 2025; Circulo (a community mutual credit currency) September 2025; Smart Agreements October 2025; Atomic multi-currency trades December 2025; blockchain bridging January and February 2026; KYC/AML integrations and token gating March 2026; data migration and recovery in progress for Q2 2026.

item.title: From complementary currency to institution: A micro-macro study of the Sardex mutual credit system
item.container-title: London School of Economics and Political Science Research Online (London School of Economics and Political Science)
item.publisher: London School of Economics and Political Science

findings.finding: Interview study of Sardex as social-innovation start-up, complementary currency, mutual credit system and socio-economic circuit: trust was and remains fundamental to creating and operating the system; Sardex became a mediator of economic exchanges and an institution at regional level.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: The main findings are that trust was and continues to be fundamentally important for the creation and operation of the mutual credit system

item.title: Complementary credit networks and macroeconomic stability: Switzerland's Wirtschaftsring

findings.finding: Studies Switzerland's Wirtschaftsring (WIR) as a complementary credit network in relation to macroeconomic stability. Neither OpenAlex nor Crossref carries the abstract, so only the title and bibliographic record were read.

item.title: Neutral Settlement Layer for Interoperability between Different Forms of Local Monetary and Financial Expression
item.container-title: International Journal of Community Currency Research

findings.finding: Proposes multilateral set-off of mutual debts as a settlement layer between non-convertible currencies and simulates clusters of companies on a dataset of more than 40,000 companies: up to 95 percent of total Net Internal Debt can be settled within communities, the remainder in outside money.
findings.exactSourceLanguage: Up to 95% of the total Net Internal Debt can be settled within the communities, with the remainder settled with outside money.
